claims.text: Silent Strider stories say Sutekh, the Egyptian god Set, once walked openly among the ancient Egyptians; vampires disagree over whether Sutekh is a vampire or only made them.
The Egyptian core of the tribe spent its history fighting Set's vampire spawn, which corrupted whole villages, while Striders on the steppe were busy elsewhere.
The tribe has long held that Sutekh is one of the mightiest avatars of the Wyrm on Gaia.

title: The Striders and the Immortals
summary: What the tribe knows of the undying of Egypt.

claims.text: Striders have seen the souls of the immortals travel to Duat when their bodies die and later return in newborn bodies.
Friendship with an immortal can be useful, but conservatives in other tribes see the immortals as blasphemers against Gaia's law.

title: The Striders in the Crusades
summary: The tribe's travels in the Dark Ages.

claims.text: The Crusades carried Wyrm creatures both ways between Europe and the Holy Land, and the Cult of Sutekh used the traffic to spread further into Europe.
The same traffic let the Striders spread their trade and travel networks into southeastern Europe, where they grew close to the Rroma, from whom much of their Kinfolk still comes.
Around 1300 the wandering Caern of Long Voyages was thrown into an attack on a Zmei's servants in southern Russia and lost with its whole sept.

title: The Harbingers
summary: Silent Striders who carry warnings of what is coming.

claims.text: The Harbingers are the tribe's second oldest camp; they say they began among the Seekers as the ones who brought back warnings.
They gather prophecies such as the Prophecy of the Phoenix and tales of the Perfect Metis, and became a camp of their own after the tribe was driven from its homeland.
Many septs dread a Harbinger's arrival, since death tends to follow, though so do battle and glory.

title: Owl, Patron of the Striders
summary: The tribe totem of the Silent Striders.

claims.text: Legend says Owl became the tribe's patron when the first Garou dared the Dark Umbra, guiding the first Strider into the Underworld and back out.
Striders cannot reach their own ancestor spirits, but owl-spirits teach them the Gifts other tribes learn from ancestors.
Sphinx and Falcon, the enemy of Sutekh, remain old friends of the tribe from its Egyptian days.
